observations: Configuration phase is from-scratch; training can explicitly load a checkpoint if supplied, so this label alone does not prove the release's entire training history.

comparison_with_other_same_name_release.method: For every ONNX initializer with more than 16 elements, compare a multiset of (shape, dtype, SHA-256 of NumPy array bytes), disregarding initializer names. Reference downloaded only into memory; no reference model retained or deployed.
comparison_with_other_same_name_release.limit: Shows distinct exports and no exact tensor matches under this comparison. Does not by itself prove independent training, exclude all derivation, or establish legal rights.

conclusion.license_basis: Publisher's Apache-2.0 declaration attached to this exact model repository/revision, rather than borrowing a license from inference or training code.
conclusion.training_attribution: Evidence supports association with Kun-Hsiang Lin / DOCSAID's matching training/export implementation. This is an inference; original checkpoints and training logs were not supplied.
conclusion.remaining_limit: No independent assurance of all training-data rights. InsightFace recognizer permission remains a separate unresolved issue.
